user_query: I'm a music lover and I'm searching for new and unique tracks to add to my personal playlist. Can you recommend some songs from the charts that are currently trending? It would be great if you could also provide me with the latest releases from the artists of these songs.

TaskList.description: 查询当前流行的歌曲排行榜，获取热门歌曲列表。
根据热门歌曲，获取对应的艺术家信息。
查询这些艺术家的最新发行作品。
